title: Count Subarrays With Majority Element II
summary: Given an integer array and a target, count the subarrays where the target appears more than half the time.
statement: Given an integer array and a target, count the subarrays where the target appears more than half the time.
constraints: nums contains up to 100,000 positive integers.
A subarray qualifies when target occurs strictly more than half its length.
Return the total qualifying subarray count.
hints: Map target to +1 and every other value to -1; a subarray has target majority exactly when its transformed sum is positive.
For each prefix sum, count earlier prefix sums that are strictly smaller.
Offset sums into positive Fenwick indices, query prefix-1, then insert the current sum.
Every qualifying subarray corresponds uniquely to an ordered prefix pair with later sum greater than earlier sum.
editorial: Every qualifying subarray corresponds uniquely to an ordered prefix pair with later sum greater than earlier sum.

tests.explanation: Five subarrays have target two as a strict majority.
All ten subarrays have target one as a strict majority.
